verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no refund API, whether for initiating or tracking refunds on agent-placed orders. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Crossmint managing disputes with the bank for the general Checkout product, authorization holds, cancellable order intents, and order-lifecycle webhooks. None of these is a programmatic refund capability for agent orders.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds on agent-placed orders can be initiated and tracked programmatically
